info.title: D-Human app API
info.description: The routes the native apps use. Every answer is private, no-store. Only a 401 means signed out. Errors are { error, message? }. Requests with Authorization must not carry Origin or Sec-Fetch-* headers.

post.summary: Sign in with the emailed code (sent by POST /api/auth/code) and get a token. Never for a browser.

parameters.name: X-DHuman-Client
parameters.description: ios/1.0.0 (42). Used only for update prompts.

code.description: Six digits, or the App Review account's 12 or more. Spaces and dashes are ignored.

key.description: A random key for this try. Send it again with a resend: the same email, code and key within 10 minutes get the same token.

label.description: The hardware model, e.g. iPhone18,1. Never the phone's name.

token.description: Shown once. Keep it in the Keychain; send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

expiresAt.description: 90 days after last use, at most 365 days after sign-in. Use slides it.

400.description: Refused: the error code says why.

error.description: A stable code to switch on.

message.description: Words to show, when the server has them.

schema.description: Every refusal. Only a 401 means signed out.

429.description: Too many tries. Retry-After says when to come back.

error.description: A stable code to switch on.

message.description: Words to show, when the server has them.

schema.description: Every refusal. Only a 401 means signed out.

contour.description: Empty when fewer than 4 markers have values: then there's no contour.

get.summary: Fuel, as the web's /fuel shows it: today's totals against targets, today's meals, the usual day, food gaps and the plan.

parameters.name: X-DHuman-Client
parameters.description: ios/1.0.0 (42). Used only for update prompts.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the app's copy.

day.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the person's own time zone.

totals.description: Today so far, from today's meals.

basis.description: How each target was set, in plain words.

estimated.description: Height, weight or age was missing.

pct.description: Share of today's need. Null for vitamin D, which shows in IU only.

iu.description: Vitamin D only: IU from today's food.

source.description: photo, voice or text; a repeat keeps its first meal's.

items.description: 'Name, portion', as the web lists them.

demo.description: Written from a template because AI is off on this server.

time.description: When it was eaten, on the person's clock: '8:40 am'.

at.description: When it was eaten: a queued meal's own time, else when it was logged.

lang.description: The language the title and tip are written in, as a BCP 47 tag ('hi', 'hi-Latn', 'en').

items.description: A logged meal: estimates, never measurements.

meals.description: Today's meals, in the order they were logged.

short.description: Too light to count: under 60% of the energy target.

gaps.description: What the person's food runs shortest of, lowest first. Empty without enough data.

stackReady.description: No report and no stack yet, but the meals are enough to build one.

queued.description: A pass bought ahead, starting when the current one ends.

free.description: true: the reads the person started with; false: a pass's.

readBlock.description: Why one more read isn't allowed now, or null.

mealBlock.description: Why one more meal log isn't allowed now, or null.

plan.description: What the person may use. No words and no price: the apps write their own, with the store's price.
